confluence_pages.title: payments-api runbook
confluence_pages.body:
h1. payments-api runbook

Owned by team payments (alice, bob). Alerts go to #payments-alerts; incidents are discussed in #incidents.

h2. Known failure modes

h3. PaymentGatewayTimeout
Symptom: log lines containing 'PaymentGatewayTimeout: gateway did not respond within 30s' from charge().
Check: error rate panel for service=payments-api; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of payments-api; if persists, page payments on-call.

h3. LedgerMismatch
Symptom: log lines containing 'LedgerMismatch: ledger balance mismatch for account' from reconcile().
Check: error rate panel for service=payments-api; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of payments-api; if persists, page payments on-call.

h2. Dashboards
Chronosphere: rate(http_requests_total{service="payments-api",code=~"5.."}[5m])
